agent_assessment: All 6 phases of the agent identity adoption plan are fully implemented. Phase 1 (CLI): identityTransport RoundTripper injects X-Agent-Identity-Token header when VROOLI_AGENT_IDENTITY_TOKEN is present; multipart requests also covered via explicit header set. Phase 2 (API middleware): Verifier interface + CLIUtilVerifier + fail-open Middleware registered globally in main.go. Phase 3 (Backlog provenance): CreatedBy *Provenance field on BacklogItem with store-level immutability (write-once in SaveItem). Phase 4 (Execution/activity): QueueBacklog and Spec.normalized() both check context provenance before defaulting. Phase 5 (UI): IdentityBadge component parses 'agent:<profile_key>/<run_id>' format, renders bot/user icons, links to agent-manager runs. Phase 6 (Tests): All 8 unit tests pass (6 middleware + 2 transport). API and CLI both build cleanly. No regressions detected.

evidence.title: Phase 1 code review — CLI identity detection and header injection
evidence.description: Verified: (1) cli/app.go calls cliutil.DetectIdentity() at startup and stores IdentityEnv on App struct. (2) cli/identity_transport.go implements http.RoundTripper that clones requests and injects X-Agent-Identity-Token header. (3) cli/helpers.go has explicit fallback header injection for multipart requests. Transport is set on http.Client before core initialization — all HTTP paths are covered.

evidence.title: Phase 2 code review — API identity middleware
evidence.description: Verified: (1) internal/identity/middleware.go defines Verifier interface with CLIUtilVerifier production impl. (2) Middleware function implements fail-open: no header → operator, valid token → agent with claims, invalid/error → operator + warning log. (3) main.go registers middleware globally via s.router.Use(identity.Middleware(identity.CLIUtilVerifier{})). (4) provenance.go provides Provenance struct with context injection/extraction and FormatStartedBy().

evidence.title: Phase 3 code review — Backlog item provenance
evidence.description: Verified: (1) backlog/types.go has CreatedBy *identity.Provenance with json:'created_by,omitempty'. (2) store.go SaveItem() checks merged map for existing created_by — if present on disk, preserves it regardless of struct value (write-once immutability). (3) handler_create.go extracts provenance from context via identity.FromContext(r.Context()) and sets CreatedBy on new items.

evidence.title: Phase 4 code review — Execution and activity provenance
evidence.description: Verified: (1) execution/service_queue.go QueueBacklog() checks identity.FromContext(ctx) when StartedBy is empty — uses prov.FormatStartedBy() for agents, falls back to 'swarm-manager' for operators. (2) agentactivity/types.go Spec.normalized() elevates RequestedBy from 'swarm-manager' to agent format when context carries agent provenance.

evidence.title: Phase 5 code review — UI IdentityBadge component
evidence.description: Verified: (1) ui/src/components/ui/identity-badge.tsx parses 'agent:<profile_key>/<run_id>' format. (2) Agent badge: violet pill with Bot icon, truncated profile_key, optional link to agent-manager run detail. (3) Operator badge: slate pill with User icon, displays value as-is. (4) execution-card.tsx imports and uses IdentityBadge for startedBy display. Component is memoized and handles null values.

improvement_suggestions.description: Add integration test that exercises the full flow: set VROOLI_AGENT_IDENTITY_TOKEN env var → CLI makes request → API middleware extracts provenance → backlog item created with agent created_by. Currently only unit tests exist for each layer independently.
